text_block_list.text: "Once upon a time, in a certain place..."

"Wings of blue and tail of blue,
Only the beak shines bright yellow!"
"Once, there was a little bird."

"The little bird was a master of flight,
Cutting through wind and piercing the clouds, sweeping with speed,
Fast, ever faster, across the sky."

"The little bird always thought to himself:
'Look at my colors, look at my frame!
The reason I can soar so high—'"

"For surely, surely...
you are the 'blue bird'...
that brings happiness to all—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Telling you 'You know, you can turn on the lights'...
feels like it was so long ago now.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ! ...Good morning, Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Good morning, Ruby.
You're up early this morning too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...You too, Miss Miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah. Even so, you still didn't
turn on the light. Even though you knew I'd wake up right away,
you still tried your best not to wake me.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(That's why our mornings, almost every single day,
start in a dimly lit room.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're heading to the track, right?
Mind if I come along?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: If we have the same destination, feel free to join me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
I'll get ready right away.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Daiichi Ruby. She's super dependable and hard on herself. But deep down, she's really kind—my precious roommate.)

text_block_list.name: Miracle & Ruby
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the early morning routine...
Miracle-san, I shall take my leave here.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, good work.
See you later, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Hmm, maybe I should
get a few more laps in—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Then next time, may I become the wind that joins yours?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr!
You're here too. Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Good morning.
It's a wonderful, calm morning, isn't it, Miracle-san?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I believe it's a fine time to blow away the morning dew.
What do you think?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah. Thanks for inviting me.
Shall we run, Zephyr?
(*pitter-patter—!!*)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Lightly, yet fiercely. You suddenly surge with speed. The word that fits you best really is... 'the wind'.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, Miracle-san! It starts right here!
Fufufu...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Yamanin Zephyr. She runs like the wind with such a pure heart—my lovely, wonderful, and precious classmate.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Heeeelp me, Mira-teacheeeer!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, FR there's a quiz period 1!? For real real??
I seriously had NO clue whatsoever, tho!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, it was mentioned after the previous class, I think...
Though it's easy to forget these things, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Do you think my notes will be of any help...?
If there's anything hard to understand, please let me know."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Miracleeeee~~~~~!!
You're a goooood~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me. I should be thanking you
for always taking such good care of me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Helios is always so bright and fun!
We're in the same grade and class, but she's a year older.
She's from Ruby's generation, so when it comes to racing, she's my senior.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(So, when you say they've always treated you well,
that means――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"A godsend...! Sorry, mind if I join in?!
I didn't totally forget, but I haven't prepared anyyything...!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Me too~! I accidentally picked up a part-time shift, so I haven't studied enough...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah! ...Somehow I'm starting to lose confidence too...! Can, can I have one too!? Miracle!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yeah.
A study group with everyone, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah~~~!
I'm. Fi. Red. UP~~~!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...Just like this. To someone like me, who barely had any friends before coming here, Helios always brings so much lively energy.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Palmer, and everyone else.
They're all my dearest friends.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Umm, what else I need today is—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Miracle! Already prepping for afternoon training?!
You're really giving it your all, huh~~~!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You too, Bamboo. It's completely clear today
and perfect weather for training, so it really gets you pumped up.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right on!!
Alright, let's keep training hard today too!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Bamboo is in the same school year, but in the Twinkle Series
she's a major senior. She's an amazing Umamusume
who's even claimed a GⅠ victory.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh, right!! That's it, that's it!
There was something I needed to tell ya!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, for me?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!
Here I go, okay? Inhaaaale......

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle!!
Congrats on locked-in debut race, suuupaaah!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah.
Thank you, Bamboo!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Roommate. Classmate. Friend. The seniors of the Twinkle Series. And—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer-san.
Are you ready to start training?
choice_data_list: You were fully prepared and waiting for me again today, huh?
You were fully prepared and waiting for me again today, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ahaha.
Sorry, I got a bit too fired up.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, at long last...!
My training for my debut is finally starting.
There's no way I can just sit still!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's get started — just take it easy, okay!
Yeah. Let's take it easy as we get started!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes. I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Trainer. You support me, and let me run like this... You are my new benefactor.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll do my best.
I'll run, and win... definitely—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I will repay you for this, I swear it.

“—From today on, full-scale training with KS Miracle has begun.
The regime will be tailored specifically for her debut race.”

However, before ramping up the workload like that,
there was something that had to be done first.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah...!
Whew...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Um... are we done?
I've still got plenty of stamina—
choice_data_list: No. Let's wrap things up and go get you examined.
No. Let's wrap it up and go get you examined.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Alright, good work to both of you.
As for the test results—

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
No particular issues were found.
For now, it should be fine to proceed with full-scale training towards their debut race.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: However—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
It is true that when she was young,
she was so frail she could barely stand.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: There is no doubt that the strain placed on her in training and racing is far greater than that of other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
So, to be blunt—
from here on out, I'm relying on you.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Please make the proper judgment.
...I beg of you.

Afterward, having discussed the future plan in detail with the attending physician,
we stepped out of the hospital—

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text: Ah... Kei-chan!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh! Mom, Dad... you came too?

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the doctor told me they're going to
do a thorough examination for my debut...

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for your hard work.
Um, for looking out for me in so many ways...
Thank you so very much.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text: I am deeply sorry that all I can do is ask this of you... but please, take good care of my daughter...!

They bowed their heads so deeply that it almost made me flustered.
Yet in that posture, I could feel the immense, wholehearted love of parents who wanted the very best for their daughter...
After watching the parent and child chat for a while after that, on the way back home.

In front of the park near the hospital,
K.S.Miracle suddenly stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —This is where I ran for the first time.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the doctors and my parents, I was able to stand first.
Then, I was able to walk.
And finally... in this very park, they told me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "You're alright now." "Go on, try running."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: At first, I took timid, cautious steps. But then I realized—there was strength returning to my legs.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I can do this. It'll be fine. Time to head to where Mom and the others are waiting for me—here I go!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I can't forget it. The way I felt back then.
The feeling of kicking off the ground for the very first time.
The warmth of being caught and held tight.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's because everyone was there that I'm standing here today.
...That's why I must fulfill it, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Repaying my debt. A miracle.
—...A GⅠ victory.
With a gentle voice that seems to melt into the night, yet carrying words steeped in strong, unwavering resolve, K.S. Miracle speaks.

At times, she doesn't hesitate to push forward—
and that "sheer lack of hesitation" makes her dangerous.
choice_data_list: (That's exactly why I've got to hold it together.)
(That's exactly why I have to hold it together.)

text_block_list.text:
From the attending physician. From her parents.
Today, the baton was handed over.

"I will protect and guide K.S. Miracle, without fail."
With this vow in my heart, I looked up at the night sky.
